INSTALLATION OF BACK DOOR GLASS
1. CLEAN BODY AND GLASS
(See page BO-34)
2. INSTALL BACK DOOR GLASS
(a) Install the dam;
Apply double-stick tape at a point 15 mm (0.59 in.)
from the glass rim.
(b) Place the dam on the double-stick tape.
HINT: Cut a V-wedge into the corner folds of the dam.
NOTICE: Do not touch the glass after cleaning it.
(c) Install the two back door glass spacers.
(d) Install the glass in the same manner as the windshield.
(See page BO-35)
